description: Permanently delete a segment. This cannot be undone. Subscribers are not affected. Deleting is never blocked when the segment is in use: the result lists `affectedSequences` (with how each uses it), `affectedCampaigns`, `affectedSegments` and `affectedAudienceSyncs`, which from then on treat every contact as not in the segment. Requires the segments:delete scope; segments:write is not enough.

companyId.description: Company ID. If not provided, uses the currently selected company.

name: delete_segment

outputSchema.description: Structured content returned by the `delete_segment` MCP tool.

affectedAudienceSyncs.description: Ad audience syncs that pushed the segment's members: id, audienceName.

items.description: One item in the returned collection.

affectedCampaigns.description: Unsent campaigns (scheduled, waiting approval, sending or paused) and live in-app campaigns that targeted or excluded the segment: id, name, status, type. The affected* fields are omitted when the usage check failed.

items.description: One item in the returned collection.

affectedSegments.description: Other segments whose rules referenced the deleted segment: id, name.

items.description: One item in the returned collection.

affectedSequences.description: Sequences (not archived) that read the deleted segment: id, name, status and usages (trigger, condition, filter, stop_condition, audience). They now treat every contact as not in the segment.
